I'm making no further changes, and the `no-test-edits` hook will keep failing. It reports the same 16 tests as last time. Nothing has changed since then, so I'm not re-running it.

Each listed test asserts the old behavior, where a declared `__proto__` is kept as an own property and validated. Your task requires the opposite: it must be stripped in every mode. Nobody is available to approve the edits, and I won't modify or bypass the hook, so I haven't tried to satisfy it.

To clear the hook, someone with authority over it needs to accept these test changes, for example by resetting its baseline. The alternative is to say you want the old behavior kept, in which case the spec and these tests conflict and I'd need to know which one wins.

The source changes are in `packages/zod/src/v4/core/schemas.ts` and `packages/zod/src/v3/types.ts`. The `packages/zod` suite passes (3918 tests). Nothing is committed.
